note: Scheduled agent task list for source preset maintenance (see .github/workflows/update-sources.yml and .github/update-sources-prompt.md). sourceId must match an id in data/sources.json sources[]. Pages are sha256-hashed on each run; a source's agent task fires only when one of its pages changed. The agent itself (model/provider) is configured in repo Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions: secret AGENT_API_KEY plus variables AGENT_MODEL, AGENT_PROVIDER_ID, AGENT_BASE_URL.

pages.expect: plan price, per-model request counts (5h/weekly/monthly), limited-time promo banners
usage limits table, per-model $/1M prices and monthly usage $ value
